inventory: AUTHOR.md files searched recursively across tasks, archives and staging; related author descriptions read before construction.
family_claim: New nonisothermal hydrodynamic noise contraction. Shared fluctuating-hydrodynamic background is explicit; no claim that all broad concepts are unrelated.

archives/screened/tasks/unsteady-sphere/.comparison: Earlier deterministic translational response omitted fluid history/added mass. This task retains the exact full unsteady rotational impedance and tests its nonisothermal noise contraction.

archives/screened/tasks/heated-filament/.comparison: Earlier white-noise mode projection omitted off-diagonal noise covariance under nonuniform heating. This task has one measured torque channel; its exact local reservoirs yield a frequency-dependent scalar noise temperature.

archives/thermal-bodies-r11/tasks/therma.comparison: Earlier structured local reservoirs omitted correlations between otherwise exact oscillator modes, changing bath-resolved mean heat. Here no mode independence or heat-current attribution is assumed; the tested closure replaces spatial reservoirs by one scalar bath temperature for a frequency-resolved sensor.

archives/screened/tasks/hydrodynamic-flu.comparison: Earlier two-bead task omitted equilibrium correlated noise required by deterministic mobility. Here uniform-temperature FDT and full hydrodynamic response are exact in both controls; only the nonisothermal frequency contraction differs.

archives/gyroscopic-noise-r1/tasks/gyros.comparison: Earlier reciprocal-noise closure omitted time-antisymmetric correlations resolved by delayed sensors. This task has no magnetic field, vector cross spectrum, or detector delay.

archives/entropy-anomaly-r2/tasks/entrop.comparison: Earlier particle calorimetry required finite-mass heat and velocity-moment relaxation in a small-mass limit. Here fluid inertia is retained at finite frequency and the observable is stationary support torque noise; no entropy definition or singular mass limit.

rejected_alternative.reason: Spatial-B positional Hall drift versus scalar Fick diffusion was an exact predecessor mechanism with neutral3/3 passes and was not rebuilt.

empirical_difficulty: Unknown until three frozen unhinted trials; scientific separation is not a difficulty result.
